entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 10-02-2025 Heard Ms. R. Saha, learned counsel for the petitioner, who has filed this application under section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail to the petitioner, namely, Gulap Ali in connection with Bongaigaon PS Case No. 270/2023 registered u/s 3 (1)/5(1)(a) of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 added sections 366A/376(3) IPC read with Section 6/17 POCSO Act.
Ms. N. Das, learned Addl. PP, Assam shall obtain the same.
Let steps be taken for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 through the Office of the PP, Assam.
